arkwys:slimefolk#desc: Being a slimefolk you are made of green slime, stronger in their natural habitat the swamp.
arkwys:slimefolk/high_jump#desc: Being a slime gives you the ability to jump higher (2 blocks).
arkwys:slimefolk/translucent_skin#desc: Your body is made of green slime. (Cosmetic)
arkwys:slimefolk/swamp_habitat#desc: You were born in the swamp and staying there makes you feel better.
arkwys:slimefolk/slime_size#desc: You are really small compared to most creatures. (One Block Height)
origins:fall_immunity#desc: You never take fall damage, no matter from which height you fall.
arkwys:credits#desc: Origins made by Arkwys and Aiko_Suzuki
arkwys:woodelf#desc: Inhabitant of the forests, elves are skillful in archery but weak in melee.
arkwys:woodelf/adept_projectiles#desc: Elves deal significantly more damage using any type of projectile than other races.
arkwys:woodelf/forest_habitat#desc: You were born in the land of bark and leaves and staying there makes you feel better.
arkwys:woodelf/light_armoured#desc: Owing to their slender nature, the heaviest armour elves can wear is netherite. (Only matters if you play with mods that add armours stronger then netherite.)
arkwys:woodelf/vegetarian#desc: Elves put animal lives at the same value as any intelligent race, they do not eat any meat.
arkwys:woodelf/weak_melee#desc: Elves aren't strong in close combat using swords or axes. They do less damage with those weapon types.
arkwys:piglinbrute#desc: Stronger variant of piglins that uses brute force to get what it wants.
origins:water_vulnerability#desc: You receive damage over time while in contact with water.
origins:no_shield#desc: The way your hands are formed provide no way of holding a shield upright.
origins:carnivore#desc: Your diet is restricted to meat, you can't eat vegetables.
origins:strong_arms#desc: You are strong enough to break natural stones without using a pickaxe.
arkwys:brute/soul_spooked#desc: You are afraid of Soul Fire, becoming weak when near it.
arkwys:brute/all_that_glitters#desc: Golden tools deal extra damage and golden armor has additional protection. Golden equipment lasts much longer, but non golden and non netherite equipment breaks faster. Armor made of netherite gives small speed boost.
arkwys:brute/axe_efficient#desc: Gold axes and netherite axes deal more damage, as brutes are efficient with them.
arkwys:deer#desc: Inhabitant of the forests and galloper of the wild, they are serene beasts that are quite mobile.
arkwys:deer/oh_deer_god#desc: When low HP, you feel the urge to escape. You gain speed and weakness
arkwys:deer/forest_native#desc: You were born in the land of bark and leaves and staying there makes you feel better.
arkwys:deer/sensitive_awareness#desc: By pressing your [Primary Ability] key, you detect players in a 50 block radius. (If a player is in a 50 block radius a sound is made.)
medievalorigins:goblin#desc: Conniving and greedy, goblins excel in one-on-one combat and gain more loot from any mobs that they kill, although their small size becomes an issue against groups of foes.
medievalorigins:goblin/cunning#desc: Goblins are cunning creatures. Their attacks do more damage than other creatures and they gain more loot from killing mobs.
medievalorigins:goblin/frail#desc: Being small has its drawbacks. Goblins' max health is reduced, as their small size makes them prone to damage.
medievalorigins:goblin/greedy#desc: Goblins have a naturally greedy disposition. Anything gilded gives significantly more benefit to them than it would to others.
medievalorigins:goblin/nippy#desc: Although short, goblins are most certainly not slow. Moderate increase to base movement speed.
medievalorigins:goblin/stunted#desc: Goblins' poor diets and genetics prevent them from growing as tall as other creatures.
medievalorigins:siren#desc: Sirens have an ensnaring beauty and an evil nature, their irresistible beauty being the downfall of many a sailor. Its up to you to use this power to its full advantage.
medievalorigins:siren/amphibious#desc: Sirens, being a subset of merpeople, can survive in water, and swim with increased speed.
medievalorigins:siren/flammable#desc: Sirens and fire do not mix well. Any contact with flames results in instant death. Be sure to watch your step in the nether!
medievalorigins:siren/holy_water#desc: Sirens have regenerative powers, which are at full force when they are in water.
medievalorigins:siren/out_of_your_depth#: Although sirens can survive just fine on land, it is not their natural environment. As such, their regenerative abilities do not apply, and any damage taken can only be healed with potions.
medievalorigins:siren/prone#desc: While sirens can regenerate their bodies, they are weak to blunt force. Melee attacks do more damage to them.
medievalorigins:siren/siren_song#desc: Sirens are known for their alluring calls. Press [Primary capacity] to make all mobs around you neutral until hit. (DOES NOT APPLY TO BOSSES, FOR OBVIOUS REASONS)
medievalorigins:siren/water_vision#desc: Sirens have superior underwater vision than other creatures.
origins:arachnid#desc: Their climbing abilities and the ability to trap their foes in spiderweb make the Arachnid perfect hunters.
origins:climbing#desc: You are able to climb up any kind of wall, not just ladders.
origins:master_of_webs#desc: You navigate cobweb perfectly, and are able to climb in them. When you hit an enemy in melee, they get stuck in cobweb for a while. Non-arthropods stuck in cobweb will be sensed by you. You are able to craft cobweb from string.
origins:fragile#desc: You have 3 less hearts of health than humans.
origins:avian#desc: The Avian race has lost their ability to fly a long time ago. Now these peaceful creatures can be seen gliding from one place to another.
origins:slow_falling#desc: You fall as gently to the ground as a feather would, unless you sneak.
origins:fresh_air#desc: When sleeping, your bed needs to be at an altitude of at least 86 blocks, so you can breathe fresh air.
origins:like_air#desc: Modifiers to your walking speed also apply while you're airborne.
origins:tailwind#desc: You are a little bit quicker on foot than others.
origins:lay_eggs#desc: Whenever you wake up in the morning, you will lay an egg.
origins:blazeborn#desc: Late descendants of the Blaze, the Blazeborn are naturally immune to the perils of the Nether.
origins:fire_immunity#desc: You are immune to all types of fire damage.
origins:nether_spawn#desc: Your natural spawn will be in the Nether.
origins:burning_wrath#desc: When on fire, you deal additional damage with your attacks.
origins:hotblooded#desc: Due to your hot body, venoms burn up, making you immune to poison and hunger status effects.
origins:elytrian#desc: Often flying around in the winds, Elytrians are uncomfortable when they don't have enough space above their head.
origins:elytra#desc: You have Elytra wings without needing to equip any.
origins:launch_into_air#desc: Every 30 seconds, you are able to launch about 20 blocks up into the air.
origins:aerial_combatant#desc: You deal substantially more damage while in Elytra flight.
origins:light_armor#desc: You can not wear any heavy armor (armor with protection values higher than chainmail).
origins:claustrophobia#desc: Being somewhere with a low ceiling for too long will weaken you and make you slower.
origins:more_kinetic_damage#desc: You take more damage from falling and flying into blocks.
origins:enderian#desc: Born as children of the Ender Dragon, Enderians are capable of teleporting but are vulnerable to water.
origins:throw_ender_pearl#desc: Whenever you want, you may throw an ender pearl which deals no damage, allowing you to teleport.
origins:pumpkin_hate#desc: You are afraid of pumpkins. For a good reason.
origins:extra_reach#desc: You can reach blocks and entities further away.
origins:feline#desc: With their cat-like appearance, the Feline scare creepers away. With the dexterity of cats, they always land safely on their feet.
origins:sprint_jump#desc: You are able to jump higher by jumping while sprinting.
origins:velvet_paws#desc: Your footsteps don't cause any vibrations which could otherwise be picked up by nearby lifeforms.
origins:nine_lives#desc: You have 1 less heart of health than humans.
origins:weak_arms#desc: When not under the effect of a strength potion, you can only mine natural stone if there are at most 2 other natural stone blocks adjacent to it.
origins:scare_creepers#desc: Creepers are scared of you and will only explode if you attack them first.
origins:cat_vision#desc: You can slightly see in the dark when not in water.
origins:human#desc: A regular human. Your ordinary Minecraft experience awaits.
origins:merling#desc: These natural inhabitants of the ocean are not used to being out of the water for too long.
origins:water_breathing#desc: You can breathe underwater, but not on land.
origins:aqua_affinity#desc: You may break blocks underwater as others do on land.
origins:like_water#desc: When underwater, you do not sink to the ground unless you want to.
origins:phantom#desc: As half-human and half-phantom beings, these creatures can switch between a Phantom and a normal form.
origins:phantomize#desc: You can switch between human and phantom form at will, but only while you are saturated enough to sprint.
origins:phasing#desc: While phantomized, you can walk through solid material, except Obsidian.
origins:burn_in_daylight#desc: You begin to burn in daylight if you are not invisible.
origins:hunger_over_time#desc: Being phantomized causes you to become hungry.
origins:shulk#desc: Related to Shulkers, the bodies of the Shulk are outfitted with a protective shell-like skin.
origins:shulker_inventory#desc: You have access to an additional 9 slots of inventory, which keep the items on death.
origins:natural_armor#desc: Even without wearing armor, your skin provides natural protection.
origins:more_exhaustion#desc: You exhaust much quicker than others, thus requiring you to eat more.
strictly:otter#desc: The 13 extant otter species are all semiaquatic, aquatic or marine, with diets based on fish and invertebrates, But with the Changing climate's and years of mutation lead by the head Otter Blaze_Kitty they have learned to adapt and consume all foods now in an attempt at pure survival!
strictly:aquatic_predator#desc: When fully submerged in water you can fight at insane speeds and temporarily on land.
strictly:otter_gods_blessing#desc: As a gift from the Otter God, you become physically stronger.
strictly:otter_pouch#desc: Sea otters have flaps of loose skin under each forearm that they use like a pocket or pouch to carry as much food as possible back to the surface. [Primary]
strictly:mini_riptide#desc: Launches You In The Direction You Are Looking At (Must Be Submerged). [Secondary]
strictly:miniature_dwarf#desc: You are slightly smaller than the regular human.
strictly:thief#desc: No one questions who they fear, once stole an entire storage room from a clan without even being seen...
strictly:superstealth#desc: When sneaking, you or any armour/items equipped are completely invisible
strictly:cloak#desc: No one questions a Thief, they only fear what he may do...(You recieve the Bag Of Spoils and 3 Diamonds that you..um.. found?
strictly:money_lover#desc: When holding a diamond you get speed II.
strictly:strong#desc: From all your thieving days you've grown quite strong, you do a little bit more damage on attacks.
strictly:night-owl#desc: You can see in the dark
strictly:priest#desc: Priest weren’t rich like the bishops. They were generally the head of a church. They often wore long black gowns.
strictly:scholar#desc: You start your adventure's with a few item's from your best friend, The Paladin, who gave his life for you and your Church. They had Expereince Bottles, Lapis Lazuil, and a Holy Locket...
strictly:nimble#desc: You have enhanced speed, from the blessings from above.
strictly:holy_curse#desc: Undead will cause you to be weaker
strictly:wildcat#desc: The larger, stronger cousin to the feline.
strictly:feline_grace#desc: Like all felines, you always land safely on your paws.
strictly:feared_hunter#desc: Creepers will turn and run at the sight of your feline apperance.
strictly:soft_paws#desc: Your a silent hunter, your steps can't be dectected.
strictly:nocturnal_eyes1#desc: When in dark places you get Night Vision.
strictly:water_weary#desc: Being a land based hunter, you exhaust more quickly in water.
strictly:call_elder#desc: Bringing the dead back to life in a devastating attack.
strictly:shaman_hood#desc: The legendary hood of the Shaman orcs, Great source of powers and protections.
strictly:withers_immunity#desc: you managed to be immune to the most powerful poison. you are immune to the effects of your attacks.
strictly:wither_explosion#desc: You have learned to use the power of the Orc God of Curse. But you are not as strong as the Orc, your power has a much longer cooldown!
strictly:skull_wand#desc: During war, orcs can rely on their faithful ally, the staff that calls the heavens
strictly:birdofparadise#desc: The untamed master of the sky's. The angelic ancestor of the Avian's
strictly:winged#desc: With your flexible wings, you can fly using a combination of flapping and gliding.
strictly:angelicgrace#desc: your mastery of flight protects you from crashing into the land
strictly:wet_wings#desc: Being born with wings makes you incapable of swimming
strictly:windsblessing#desc: You are blessed by the winds of paradise. Thus are immune to slowness
strictly:knight#desc: Someone who is given a special honor and the title of Sir by the king or queen of England. They where made/dubbed a knight.
strictly:skofnung#desc: One of the most famous swords in Icelandic literature, Skofnung first belonged to legendary Danish king Hrolf Kraki.
strictly:skilled_swordsman#desc: Holding the Skofnung will give you 1.5 extra Damage Boost while attacking
strictly:bowless#desc: You can not use a bow or crossbow
strictly:book#desc: A Book with instructions on how to repair your sword
strictly:crescent_worship#desc: Heal and get boosted attack speed for 30 seconds.
strictly:paladin#desc: A holy knight, crusading in the name of good and order, and is a divine spellcaster. From 1st through 3rd edition, paladins were required to maintain the Lawful Good alignment.
strictly:holy_fire#desc: The power of the lord will set the undead on fire from a touch from you!
strictly:dried_out#desc: Heavily decreased walk speed when in the Nether.
strictly:leech#desc: Killing will grant you holy water.(you will heal a little)
strictly:durendal#desc: Durendal is the sword of Roland, a legendary paladin, and he has passed it down to you to weild his powerful sword.
strictly:skilled_swordsman_1#desc: Holding the Durendal will give you 1.5 extra Damage Boost while attacking
strictly:praise_the_sun#desc: Heal and gain resistance as well as regeneration for 10 seconds.( only works in the daytime )
strictly:plantaemancer#desc: Also known as floramancers, plantaemancers are people who use the power of nature, specifically plants. They do not simply use them as appendages as most druids do with spells like druidcraft or entangle. Origin Made for my wife. Subject_Re
strictly:poison_ivy_vines#desc: Send out a vine that applies poison to the target.
strictly:plant_caretaker#desc: Shift right click plants with an empty hand to make them grow.
strictly:flammable#desc: Take extra damage from fire and lava.
strictly:light_deprivation#desc: Weakness when in low light levels.
strictly:high_elf#desc: Elves are intelligent, long-living residents of the forest. Their skills in archery prove useful from afar, but their frailness becomes an issue up close.
strictly:flamethrower#desc: Shoot out a flame Bolt that will light your enemys on fire.
strictly:forest_vision#desc: Centuries of living in the forest has given the elves far better perception in the dark than most.
strictly:hyper_sight#desc: Elves' enhanced perception allows them to keep track of an enemy for a while after hitting them, even when they aren't in view.
strictly:towering#desc: Elves are substantially taller than the average human. Despite this, they are just as skinny...
strictly:vegetarian#desc: Elves live off of the forest and its fruits. Their digestive systems cannot process meat.
strictly:spindly#desc: Owing to their slender nature, the heaviest armour elves can wear is chainmail.
strictly:jump3#desc: High Elfs, being so tall can also jump quite high as well.
cisco_rpg_origins:demi_god_umbra#desc: The offspring of a dark primordial god and a human.  A dark power slumbers within you unable to be fully utilised.
cisco_rpg_origins:divine_strength#desc: Your divine heritage grants you might. You do 40% increased damage.
cisco_rpg_origins:hubris#desc: Your natural strength makes you prideful .. careless.You take 20 percent increased damage.
cisco_rpg_origins:umbral_lineage#desc: Regions with strong umbral energy empower you. You take 15 % less damage in the end.
cisco_rpg_origins:dark_vision#desc: Darkness does not obscure you and you may freely see within it.
cisco_rpg_origins:divine_hunger#desc: Your stomach craves divine sustinence and as such you may only eat golden apples ,carrots and certain other divine foods.
cisco_rpg_origins:divine_body#desc: Your divine body is strong granting you increased base health.
cisco_rpg_origins:demi_god_lux#desc: The offspring of a holy primordial god and a human. Holy light courses through you unable to radiate fully.
cisco_rpg_origins:luxian_lineage#desc: Light from the heavens empower you. You take 10 % less damage when exposed to the sky.
cisco_rpg_origins:lightbringer#desc: As the light bringer your are immune to darkness and wither effects.
cisco_rpg_origins:venthari_sharpshooter#: You are born of the wind nation , renowned for thier excellent archers. Your hand is steady and your aim is true.
cisco_rpg_origins:deadeye#desc:
You have trained with a bow all your life .
You deal 30 percent increased projectile damage.
cisco_rpg_origins:carnivore#desc: High quality plant life don't grow easily in the barren deserts of venthari. Your people have adapted to eating mostly meat.
cisco_rpg_origins:terrain#desc: You feel at home in hot climates but encumbered in cold ones. You gain increased speed in hot biomes but slowness in cold ones.
cisco_rpg_origins:terrain2#desc: You feel at home in hot climates but encumbered in cold ones. You gain increased speed in hot biomes but slowness in cold ones.
cisco_rpg_origins:fragility#desc:
Venthari aren't known for being sturdy.
You have 30 percent less hp.
cisco_rpg_origins:hobrosi_dark_mage#desc: You are a dark mage from Anthrax the veiled land of darkness . Dark magic bends effortlessly to your will,  while your enemies break.
cisco_rpg_origins:ender_affinity#desc: Your body courses with anthrax's dark magic. You gain a 350 % boost to ender spell power.
cisco_rpg_origins:holy_rebuke#desc: Tainted by anthrax's dark magic his sister lumera sees you as filth and rebukes you. You gain a 350 % penalty to holy spell power.
cisco_rpg_origins:dark_blessing#desc: You pledge your soul to anthrax and so he grants you a small portion of his power. You gain extra mana and cast spells 2x faster.
cisco_rpg_origins:dl_blessing#desc: You devote yourself to lumera and she grants you a small portion of her power. You gain extra mana and cast spells 2x faster.
cisco_rpg_origins:magic_missle_expert#de: You have honed the magic missile to it's limits able to cast it at max level at will. (default key ) (g)
cisco_rpg_origins:ethereal_evasion#desc: Become one with the shadows dodging  incoming attacks. (default key ) (h)
cisco_rpg_origins:profane_sacrifice#desc: Anthrax demands blood in exchange for power. You have 40 percent less hp.
cisco_rpg_origins:rastrayian_justicar#de: Lumera your home, holy magic your weapon, the forces of darkness your sworn enemy.
cisco_rpg_origins:rastraiya_might#desc: Justicars are blessed with the goddess' holy might granting them a 350% boost to holy spell power.
cisco_rpg_origins:ender_rebuke#desc: Anthrax rebukes the followers of his sister Lumera shutting of his domain to you. You gain a 350% penalty to ender spell power.
cisco_rpg_origins:holy_blessing#desc: You devote yourself to lumera and so she grants you a small portion of her power. You gain extra mana and cast spells 2x faster.
cisco_rpg_origins:guiding_bolt_expert#de: You have honed the guiding bolt to it's limits able to cast it at max level at will. (default key ) (g)
cisco_rpg_origins:fortify#desc: Bless yourself and allies in holy light fortifying them against damage. (default key ) (h)
cisco_rpg_origins:righteous_respite#desc: The weight of your oath burdens you immensely. You are 30 % percent slower.
cisco_rpg_origins:frijani_drengr#desc: Born of the ice tribes within the nation of frijani you've known nothing but harsh winters and fierce battles, making you strong.
cisco_rpg_origins:berserkergang#desc: You fight with the fury gods taking 30 increased damage but gaining 20 percent lifesteal.
cisco_rpg_origins:chilled_blades#desc: Your chilled blades grant 20 percent crit chance and 50 percent crit dmg and slow enemies hit.
cisco_rpg_origins:reckless_fury#desc: Your rage makes your predictable and likely to miss. You deal 20 percent less damage .
cisco_rpg_origins:andhrimnir#desc: Your appetite is as insatiable as that of the god of food Andhrimnir. You exhaust much quicker.
cisco_rpg_origins:skjoldur#desc: Your intense focus on offence prevents you from using shields in combat.
cisco_rpg_origins:pyrios_pheonix_knight#: Born of the fire kingdom Pyrios you managed to join the distinguished order of the Pheonix Knights. Fire and blade your tenet.
cisco_rpg_origins:infernal_blade#desc: Your weapons are infused with potent fire magic. You do bonus fire damage on hit and may ignite enemies.
cisco_rpg_origins:damnation_of_pyr#desc: The flame god pyr delights in your incineration of foes in his name. Ignited targets take 60 % more damage from you.
cisco_rpg_origins:solar_eclipse#desc: You derive your power from exposure to the sun. When not exposed you become weakened and slowed.
cisco_rpg_origins:pheonix_renewal#desc: The fiery embrace of the sun rejuvenates your body and spirit .While under the radiance of the sun you regenerate health quickly.
cisco_rpg_origins:endothermic#desc: Extreme cold disrupts the flame magic cycling through your body causing you to be more fragile. Your hp is reduced by 40 % in very cold biomes .
cisco_rpg_origins:flame_god_might#desc: Members of the order of the pheonix profiecient in the use of fire magic but frown on the use of ice magic. As such you gain a 200 % boost to fire magic but an equal penalty to ice magic.
cisco_rpg_origins:burning_dash_expert#de: Dash forward in a furious blaze incinerating anything in your path. (default key ) (g)
cisco_rpg_origins:flame_god_might2#desc: Members of the order of the pheonix profiecient in the use of fire magic but frown on the use of ice magic. As such you gain a 200 % boost to fire magic but an equal penalty to ice magic.
origins-classes:blacksmith#desc: Valued friends of anyone, Blacksmiths are able to create better tools, weapons and armor.
origins-classes:quality_equipment#desc: Equipment you create provides small buffs.
origins-classes:efficient_repairs#desc: Repairing equipment in an anvil costs less material. Repairing by combining equipment restores more durability.
origins-classes:cleric#desc: They have learned how to channel the magic present in the world and use that to their advantage.
origins-classes:potion_bonus#desc: As a last step in potion brewing, you may refine the potion with water from a cauldron. Refined potions will have strengthened instant effects and longer lasting effects.
origins-classes:better_enchanting#desc: You are able achieve higher enchantment levels at an enchantment table.
origins-classes:cook#desc: There is no one better to prepare your food than a Cook.
origins-classes:better_crafted_food#desc: Food crafted by you is more saturating.
origins-classes:more_smoker_xp#desc: You receive more experience from cooking food in a smoker.
origins-classes:farmer#desc: Farmers have been known to provide everyone with food for as long as anyone can remember.
origins-classes:more_crop_drops#desc: When harvesting crops, there is a chance that you receive twice the yield.
origins-classes:better_bone_meal#desc: Bone meal is twice as effective in your experienced hands when used on crops and plants.
origins-classes:rancher#desc: Making the most of animals, Ranchers are able to gather many useful resources.
origins-classes:twin_breeding#desc: Animals bred by you have a chance to produce two babies.
origins-classes:more_animal_loot#desc: You are able to sometimes receive more material from killing animals.
origins-classes:miner#desc: Miners are the most proficient at digging up the earth's treasures.
origins-classes:more_stone_break_speed#d: You mine stone material quicker than others.
origins-classes:no_mining_exhaustion#des: Breaking blocks doesn't cause you to exhaust.
origins-classes:rogue#desc: Usually known to be thieves and robbers, rogues are proficient in ambushes and stealth attacks.
origins-classes:sneaky#desc: Your nameplate is never visible through walls, even when you're not sneaking.
origins-classes:stealth#desc: When you have been sneaking for 10 seconds, you enter Stealth.
origins-classes:stealth_core#desc: While in stealth, you make less sound and deal extra damage when attacking an enemy from behind. You exit Stealth when you stop sneaking.
origins-classes:warrior#desc: These honorable fighters favor the sword and shield to take down their foes.
origins-classes:more_attack_damage#desc: Able to use each weapon to its fullest potential, you deal a bit more damage.
origins-classes:less_shield_slowdown#des: You are slowed down less when protecting yourself with a shield.
origins-classes:no_projectile_divergence: All of your projectiles have increased accuracy.
origins-classes:less_bow_slowdown#desc: You can move quicker than others while drawing your bow.
origins-classes:beastmaster#desc: Beastmasters are solitary people who prefer the company of animals.
origins-classes:tamed_animal_boost#desc: Animals you tame receive a permanent buff to their health and strength.
origins-classes:tamed_potion_diffusal#de: Your nearby tamed animals also receive potion effects when you drink a potion.
origins-classes:lumberjack#desc: Trees should watch out when Lumberjacks are around.
origins-classes:tree_felling#desc: You cut down whole trees at once, unless you sneak.
origins-classes:more_planks_from_logs#de: You gain two more wooden planks from a single log when crafting.
origins-classes:explorer#desc: Explorers find their way through the most difficult terrain easily and discover hidden landmarks.
origins-classes:explorer_kit#desc: You start the game with a compass, a clock and nine empty maps.
origins-classes:no_sprint_exhaustion#des: Sprinting doesn't cause you to exhaust.
origins-classes:nitwit#desc: Nitwits aren't really good at anything.
cisco_rpg_origins:amaterasus_blessing#de: You are favoured by amaterasu goddess of the sun. You recieve her radiant blessing.
cisco_rpg_origins:amaterasus_boon_minor#: Amaterasu blesses your body granting you a +10 boost to max health .
cisco_rpg_origins:amaterasus_boon_major#: Upon slaying the ender dragon, Amaterasu grants you a permanent 20 % boost to max health and boosted regeneration.
cisco_rpg_origins:amaterasus_boon_major2: Upon slaying the ender dragon, Amaterasu grants you a permanent 20% boost to max health and boosted regeneration.
cisco_rpg_origins:athenas_blessing#desc: You are favoured by athena goddess of wisdom.She grants you her protective blessing.
cisco_rpg_origins:athenas_boon_minor#des: Athena blesses your armor granting you a +12 boost .
cisco_rpg_origins:athenas_boon_major#des: Upon slaying the ender dragon, Athena grants you a permanent 25 percent reduction to all incoming damage.
cisco_rpg_origins:neptunes_blessing#desc: You are favoured by neptune god of waters and seas. He grants you his tidal blessing.
cisco_rpg_origins:neptunes_boon_minor#de: You are strengthened by the tides. You deal 80 percent increased damage under water.
cisco_rpg_origins:neptunes_boon_major#de: Upon slaying the ender dragon, Neptune grants the the ability to breath , see clearly and mine faster underwater.
cisco_rpg_origins:skadis_blessing#desc: You are favoured by skadi icy goddess of the wilderness. She grants you her frigid blessing.
cisco_rpg_origins:skadis_boon_minor#desc: While within skadi's domain she grants you strength. You deal 14 percent increased damage in cold biomes.
cisco_rpg_origins:skadis_boon_major#desc: Upon slaying the ender dragon, Skadi grants you a permanent 25 percent boost to projectile damage.
cisco_rpg_origins:ras_blessing#desc: You are favoured by Ra god of the sun , light and order.  You recieve his Radiant blessing.
cisco_rpg_origins:ras_boon_minor#desc: Ra blesses your weapons granting you a + 11 boost to fire damage when exposed to the sun.
cisco_rpg_origins:ras_boon_major#desc: Upon slaying the ender dragon, Ra grants you an additional + 10 to fire damage.
cisco_rpg_origins:chiron_blessing#desc: You are favoured by Chiron the great centaurian healer and teacher. You recieve his sagacious blessing.
cisco_rpg_origins:chiron_boon_minor#desc: Chiron imparts his teachings to you granting triple the normal experience gained from all sources.
cisco_rpg_origins:chiron_boon_major#desc: Upon slaying the ender dragon, Chiron grants you his supreme healing prowess, increasing healing from all sources , granting overheal and periodically healing you.
cisco_rpg_origins:chiron_boon_major2#des: Upon slaying the ender dragon, Chiron grants you his supreme healing prowess, increasing healing from all sources , granting overheal and periodically healing you.
cisco_rpg_origins:boreas_blessing#desc: You are favoured by Boreas god of ice and the north wind. You recieve his Frigid blessing.
cisco_rpg_origins:boreas_boon_minor#desc: Boreas blesses your weapons granting you a plus 9 boost to cold damage.
cisco_rpg_origins:boreas_boon_major#desc: Upon slaying the ender dragon, Boreas grants you an additional + 25 to cold damage.
cisco_rpg_origins:lokis_blessing#desc: You are favoured by Loki god of mischief. You recieve his devious blessing.
cisco_rpg_origins:lokis_boon_minor#desc: Loki grants you a small portion of his dark magic. You gain increased reach, true invisibility  while sneaking and your attacks also poison your foes.
cisco_rpg_origins:lokis_boon_minor2#desc: Loki grants you a small portion of his dark magic. You gain increased reach, true invisibility while sneaking and your attacks also poison your foes.
cisco_rpg_origins:lokis_boon_minor3#desc: Loki grants you a small portion of his dark magic. You gain increased reach, true invisibility while sneaking and your attacks also poison your foes.
cisco_rpg_origins:lokis_boon_major#desc: Upon slaying the ender dragon, Loki grants you the ability to blink to a thrown projectile (defauly key (x)). You also deal 40 percent increased damage to poisoned targets.
cisco_rpg_origins:lokis_boon_major2#desc: Upon slaying the ender dragon, Loki grants you the ability to blink to a thrown projectile (defauly key (x)). You also deal 40 percent increased damage to poisoned targets.
cisco_rpg_origins:susanoos_blessing#desc: You are favoured by susanoo god of storms. He grants you his tempestuous blessing.
cisco_rpg_origins:susanoos_boon_minor#de: Susanoo blesses your movement . You gain a  15 % boost to movement speed.
cisco_rpg_origins:susanoos_boon_major#de: Upon slaying the ender dragon, Susanoo grants you a permanent 25% boost to attack speed and immunity to slowness.
cisco_rpg_origins:susanoos_boon_major2#d: Upon slaying the ender dragon, Susanoo grants you a permanent 25% boost to attack speed and immunity to slowness.
cisco_rpg_origins:thors_blessing#desc: You are favoured by thor god of lightning and strength . He grants you his thunderous blessing.
cisco_rpg_origins:thors_boon_minor#desc: Thor empowers your strikes. You gain +9 to your attack.
cisco_rpg_origins:thors_boon_major#desc: Upon slaying the ender dragon, Thor grants you a 15 percent increase to damage dealt.
cisco_rpg_origins:zephyrus_blessing#desc: You are favoured by zephyrus god of the west wind. You recieve his windy blessing.
cisco_rpg_origins:zephyrus_boon_minor#de: Zephyrus' gentle winds guide your movement , you take no fall damage and jump higher whilst sprinting.
cisco_rpg_origins:zephyrus_boon_major#de: Upon slaying the ender dragon,Zephyrus grants you winged flight. Flap your wings by pressing (default key (h).
cisco_rpg_origins:no_blessing#desc: You renounce the gods and walk your path alone. You recieve no blessing.
cisco_rpg_origins:ares_blessing#desc: You are favoured by Ares god of war and courage. You recieve his ferocious blessing.
cisco_rpg_origins:ares_boon_minor#desc: Ares blesses your strikes granting you 10 percent increased critical chance.
cisco_rpg_origins:ares_boon_major#desc: Upon slaying the ender dragon, Ares lends you a portion of his might. You gain an additional 20 percent crit chance and 40 percent crit damage.
cisco_rpg_origins:ares_boon_major2#desc: Ares lends you a portion of his might. You gain an addition 20 percent crit chance and 40 percent crit damage.
cisco_rpg_origins:arthurs_blessing#desc: You are favoured by Arthur the legendary warrior king. You recieve his chivalric blessing.
cisco_rpg_origins:arthurs_boon_minor#des: Arthur's blessing boosts your courage against the forces of darkness. You deal 60 percent increased damage to undead.
cisco_rpg_origins:arthurs_boon_major#des: Upon slaying the ender dragon, Arthur exalts your weapon granting you fire damage , attack damage and attack speed.
cisco_rpg_origins:arthurs_boon_major2#de: Upon slaying the ender dragon, Arthur exalts your weapon granting you increased fire damage , attack damage and attack speed.
cisco_rpg_origins:arthurs_boon_major3#de: Upon slaying the ender dragon, Arthur exalts your weapons granting you increased attack range , attack damage and attack speed.
cisco_rpg_origins:babayaga_blessing#desc: You are favoured by the Baba Yaga the slavic witch of the cauldron. You recieve her wicked blessing.
cisco_rpg_origins:babayaga_boon_minor#de: The Baba Yaga brew's afflict your enemies. On hit weaken and wither your foes.
cisco_rpg_origins:babayaga_boon_major#de: Baba Yaga's brews become more potent, enemies afflicted by weakness or wither deal 45 percent less damage to you.
cisco_rpg_origins:vishnus_blessing#desc: You are favoured by Vishnu god of preservation, balance and sustenence. You recieve his protective blessing.
cisco_rpg_origins:vishnu_boon_minor#desc: Vishnu blesses your life force granting you a strong regeneration effect.
cisco_rpg_origins:vishnu_boon_major#desc: Upon slaying the ender dragon, Vishnu grants you permanent absorbtion and 15 percent damage reduction.
cisco_rpg_origins:vishnu_boon_major2#des: Upon slaying the ender dragon, Vishnu grants you permanent absorbtion and 15 percent damage reduction.
cisco_rpg_origins:hephaestus_blessing#de: You are favoured by Hephaestus god of forges and volcanoes. You recieve his fiery blessing.
cisco_rpg_origins:hephaestus_boon_minor#: Hephaestus blesses your weapon granting you the the ability to Fell Giants. You gain 2 percent current hp damage on all your strikes.
cisco_rpg_origins:hephaestus_boon_major#: Upon slaying the ender dragon, Hephaestus grants you a portion of his might. Your strikes reduce enemy hp to cinders with an additional 4 percent current hp damage.
